summary: CarbonSix (carbon6robotics.com) scores 32/100 across our investment thesis criteria. The company appears to be developing robotics solutions for carbon capture or industrial automation, but lacks sufficient evidence across all five pillars—Team, Defensibility, Product, Market & Why-Now, and Traction/Freshness—to warrant further engagement at this stage. The low score reflects minimal visible traction, unclear technical differentiation, and an unproven team in a capital-intensive hardware category.
rationale: Team: No publicly identifiable founding team with deep robotics or carbon-tech domain expertise; LinkedIn presence is sparse with <5 employees visible. Defensibility: No patents filed (USPTO search), no published technical whitepapers, and hardware moats in carbon capture robotics are unproven without IP or manufacturing scale. Product: Website shows renderings and concept descriptions only—no demo videos, spec sheets, or evidence of deployed units. Market & Why-Now: Carbon capture robotics is a nascent niche with unclear TAM; policy tailwinds (IRA 45Q) exist but favor established point-source capture, not robotic deployment. Traction/Freshness: Zero announced pilots, LOIs, or paying customers; domain registered 2023, no press coverage, no fundraising announcements. The 32/100 score reflects a pre-seed concept stage with high technical and commercial risk and no validation signals.
changeMyMind: Announces a paid pilot with a named industrial partner (e.g., cement, steel, or DAC facility) with defined success metrics
Files 2+ utility patents on core robotic manipulation or CO2 handling IP and hires a CTO with PhD in robotics/mechanical engineering from a top program
Closes a pre-seed round led by a climate-tech specialist VC (e.g., Lowercarbon, Breakthrough Energy Ventures) at a reasonable valuation
